Subject: Triton Ratings Assembly Competition

Hello sm1lies,

The prize money and timeline of the Triton Ratings Assembly have been increased!  First prize has been increased to $500; the registration period now ends 08.09.2008 at 9 AM EST and submission will end 08.10.2008 at 9 AM EST.

The task is to assemble and configure the rating module, both on the client side and service side.  Note: There are only two pages involved ? Get Rating and Save Rating.  

The service side is a web service layer provided through Apache CXF and Spring Framework in Java. The client side is a web UI driven by the ASP.NET Front Controller component. HTML output will be generated using XSLT. HTML prototype has been converted to XSL files. The XSL files will be provided. An assembly base will also be given. The assembly base provides the stuff related to web service and authorization logic that this assembly will make use of. 

Competition tasks:

Setup database and tables, configure Hibernate mapping files.
* Configure the persistence, services, delegates and web service within the Spring Framework. Sample Spring configurations will be provided.
* Configure the front controller, command factories and the flow of each page. A typical flow is like this: authorize, validate, web service (one or more), transform.
* Configure the validation rule for each page.
* Make sure the web UI displays the correct output under different conditions, e.g. normal output, authorization error, validation error, unexpected error. Assemblers need to write or correct XSL files if necessary.
* Write any necessary AJAX code.
* Provide directions for configuration and deployment. 
  
Registration is now open and will end 08.09.2008; the submission period will end 08.10.2008.       

Learn more at: http://www.topcoder.com/tc?module=ProjectDetail&pj=30004872

- The TopCoder Software Team
